# CoexistencePhaseDiagram

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A phase diagram where distinct phases (topological Anderson insulator and multifractal critical) coexist in parameter space, often separated by mobility edges. Mapping coexistence regions enables precise control over phase transitions in physical implementations, guiding the design of hybrid topological-reservoir systems for adaptive computing.
